MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink bundle feels like a useful next step because it connects my recent Alexa devices with my earlier interest in door and window security.",
    "USB extension cables support the computer peripherals I already use, while a portable WD drive would give me a separate backup alongside my older desktop drive. Both offer a concrete additional use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another card reader duplicates the WARRKY reader I already have, and a larger memory card does not address a current storage need.",
    "The internal drives and SSD enclosure assume an upgrade project or spare components I do not have. A ready-to-use external drive fits my needs better.",
    "The Echo Dot is familiar and appealing, but I recently bought a fourth-generation Dot and an Echo Show. The Fire tablet also interests me without giving me a clear reason to add another screen."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My history with storage accessories seems to have been taken as interest in almost any storage product, although backups, memory cards, and internal upgrades serve different purposes for me.",
    "My recent Amazon device purchases seem to suggest I want more similar devices, even when another speaker or screen would overlap with what I just bought."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already have matters: an additional accessory needs to add a useful capability rather than repeat a job my existing equipment handles.",
    "I need a practical reason to buy now. Easier USB access, a separate portable backup, and connected home security provide that reason; an unspecified hardware upgrade does not."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in practical electronics and Alexa devices, but sometimes confuse familiar products with useful next purchases."
}
